item.cold_weapons.battery_hint: Right-click with a battery (RPM) to recharge
item.cold_weapons.throw.hint: Sneak, hold right-click, then release to throw. A longer hold throws harder. Headshots deal ×%s damage.
item.cold_weapons.saw.use: Hold right-click to spin the blade. Spinning spends charge.
item.cold_weapons.sawsword.use: Right-click to toggle the blade. Running spends charge and deals more damage.
item.cold_weapons.taser.use: Right-click to fire. Stun lasts %s s. Reload takes %s s. Range %s.
jei.cold_weapons.found: Found in the world, or placed by the map.
jei.cold_weapons.found_rpm: Found in the world, or crafted with Roleplay Materials when that mod is installed.
jei.cold_weapons.found_craft: Found in the world. It also has a crafting recipe, and a Roleplay Materials recipe when that mod is installed.
jei.cold_weapons.bc: Better Combat is optional and adds attack animations.
jei.cold_weapons.use.throw: Sneak, hold right-click, then release to throw. A longer hold throws harder. Headshots deal bonus damage.
jei.cold_weapons.use.saw: Hold right-click to spin. Spinning spends charge. A Roleplay Materials battery recharges it.
jei.cold_weapons.use.sawsword: Right-click toggles the blade. It hits softer while idle and harder while running. Running spends charge. A Roleplay Materials battery recharges it.
jei.cold_weapons.use.taser: Right-click fires one dart. A hit stuns. Walking out of range breaks the wire and ends the stun. The bar is the reload. A Roleplay Materials battery restores durability.
jei.cold_weapons.use.shield: Block like a vanilla shield. Repair it in an anvil with a Roleplay Materials plank.
jei.cold_weapons.use.tool: Hit with the attack button. It also breaks blocks the way the matching vanilla tool does.
jei.cold_weapons.about.hammer: A short hammer for close swings.
jei.cold_weapons.about.sledgehammer: A heavy sledgehammer. Slow, and it hits hard.
jei.cold_weapons.about.jigsaw: A hand saw used as a weapon.
jei.cold_weapons.about.screwdriver: A small screwdriver. Fast, and light on damage.
jei.cold_weapons.about.knife: A kitchen knife. It also throws.
jei.cold_weapons.about.cleaver: A heavy kitchen cleaver. It also throws.
jei.cold_weapons.about.military_knife: A military knife. It also throws.
jei.cold_weapons.about.rake: A garden rake with a long reach.
jei.cold_weapons.about.nailed_bat: A baseball bat with nails driven through it.
jei.cold_weapons.about.spear_knife: A kitchen knife lashed to a shaft.
jei.cold_weapons.about.bottle: A broken bottle. The last hit shatters it.
jei.cold_weapons.about.stop_sign: A stop sign on its pole. Slow and heavy.
jei.cold_weapons.about.crowbar: A crowbar. It hits, and it does not mine.
jei.cold_weapons.about.sawsword: A chainsaw sword with a charge pool.
jei.cold_weapons.about.mech_saw: A circular saw with a charge pool.
jei.cold_weapons.about.taser: A taser that fires one dart and draws two wires.
jei.cold_weapons.about.wood_shield: A wooden shield with half the durability of a vanilla shield.
